en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a small town with classic Central European architecture nestled at the foot of a prominent, steep, rocky hill covered in trees. In the background, a wide valley stretches into the horizon. The postcard has scalloped edges, characteristic of early-to-mid 20th century prints. No visible text or title is present on the image side.
